nodes.description: Timestamp after which claiming is allowed, set at 1629990000 and modifiable by the owner.
Ether price per claimable token, default 0.08 ether, owner adjustable.
Counter of all minted tokens, exposed through totalSupply().
Maximum number of tokens a single wallet may claim (50).
Number of tokens reserved for rewards and wages (240).
Running count of tokens already reserved by the owner.
Mapping tracking how many tokens each address has claimed.
Array of token ids still available to be claimed; consumed as a swap-and-pop pool.
Array of collaborators and their basis-point cuts used for withdrawal splitting.
Base URI prefix used to build token metadata URIs.
Owner address maintained by the Ownable module and used by onlyOwner.
External payable function allowing a single token claim per call.
External payable function allowing a batch claim of up to 50 tokens.
Owner-only batch mint of 80 reserved tokens from the available pool.
Owner-only function that splits and transfers the contract balance to collaborators via transfer.
Owner-only registration of collaborators whose cuts must total 10000 basis points.
Owner-only setter for the per-token claim price.
Owner-only population of the availableTokens pool over an inclusive range.
Owner-only setter for the timestamp when claiming opens.
Private helper that draws a pseudo-random available token id and removes it from the pool.
Private view helper that derives a pseudo-random value from block and sender data.
Internal fixed-point multiplication used to compute collaborator payout shares.
Modifier requiring tx.origin == msg.sender to block contract callers.
Modifier requiring the claim window to be open based on block.timestamp.
Modifier restricting execution to the address stored in _owner.
Owner-only setter for the metadata base URI.
Internal batch mint that increments balances and assigns ownership in a loop.
Internal single-token mint that writes _balances and _owners.
Private helper that performs an external callback to the receiving contract on safe transfers.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, claim accounting and random seed.
Miner-influenced timestamp compared against startClaimDate in the claimStarted modifier.
Transaction origin checked against msg.sender in the callerIsUser modifier.
Pseudo-random generation from availableTokens.length, blockhash, block.coinbase, block.difficulty and msg.sender, which is predictable and manipulable.
External call into an arbitrary receiver contract via onERC721Received, a potential reentrancy entry point.
Native value push to collaborator addresses inside withdraw.
Caller supplied number of tokens requested in claimTokens.
Exclusive upper bound passed to _getRandomNumber for the modulo.
Array of collaborator structs supplied to addCollaborators.
New claim price supplied to setClaimPrice.
New base URI supplied to setBaseTokenURI.
Pseudo-random index into availableTokens inside getTokenToBeClaimed.
Selected token id returned by getTokenToBeClaimed.
Snapshot of address(this).balance inside withdraw.
Accumulator of collaborator cuts validated against basisPoints.
Lower bound of the token id range in addAvailableTokens.
Upper bound of the token id range in addAvailableTokens.

edges.reason: block.timestamp is read by the claimStarted modifier to decide whether claiming is open, creating a miner-influenced time dependency.
tx.origin is consumed by the callerIsUser modifier as an access control check.
msg.sender is compared with tx.origin inside the callerIsUser modifier.
msg.sender drives claim accounting and minting in claimToken.
msg.sender is used for per-wallet accounting and mint recipient in claimTokens.
msg.sender is one of the inputs to the pseudo-random hash in _getRandomNumber.
claimPrice is compared against msg.value in claimToken.
claimPrice multiplied by amount is compared against msg.value in claimTokens.
claimedTokensPerWallet is read and incremented to enforce the per-wallet limit in claimToken.
claimedTokensPerWallet is read and incremented by amount in claimTokens.
availableTokens.length is checked to ensure tokens remain in claimToken.
availableTokens.length is compared against amount in claimTokens.
availableTokens.length is required to be at least 80 in reserveDjens.
availableTokens is indexed, swapped and popped inside getTokenToBeClaimed.
availableTokens.length is an input to the pseudo-random hash in _getRandomNumber.
totalMintedTokens is incremented on each successful claimToken.
totalMintedTokens is incremented by amount in claimTokens.
totalMintedTokens is increased by 80 in reserveDjens.
totalReserved is compared against resDjens to cap reservations.
totalReserved is read and incremented by 80 in reserveDjens.
maxClaimsPerWallet bounds the per-wallet claim counter in claimToken.
maxClaimsPerWallet bounds claimedTokensPerWallet plus amount in claimTokens.
baseURI is overwritten by setBaseTokenURI.
collaborators is pushed to and validated in addCollaborators.
collaborators is iterated to compute payout shares in withdraw.
msg.sender feeds the predictable pseudo-random seed, making the draw attacker-influenceable.
The amount parameter controls loop count, pricing and per-wallet accounting in claimTokens.
The _upper parameter bounds the modulo result in _getRandomNumber.
The _collaborators parameter is copied into the collaborators array.
The _claimPrice parameter is written to claimPrice.
The _uri parameter is written to baseURI.
The from parameter is the starting index of the push loop in addAvailableTokens.
The to parameter is the inclusive end of the push loop in addAvailableTokens.
The local random value is produced by _getRandomNumber inside getTokenToBeClaimed.
The local tokenId is read from availableTokens and returned by getTokenToBeClaimed.
The local totalBalance snapshot determines the amounts pushed by the ether transfers.
The local totalCut accumulator is validated against basisPoints in addCollaborators.
_getRandomNumber produces the weak randomness used to select claimable tokens.
claimStarted gates execution of claimToken based on block.timestamp.
callerIsUser gates execution of claimToken using tx.origin.
claimStarted gates execution of claimTokens based on block.timestamp.
callerIsUser gates execution of claimTokens using tx.origin.
onlyOwner restricts withdraw to the owner.
onlyOwner restricts addCollaborators to the owner.
onlyOwner restricts setBaseTokenURI to the owner.
onlyOwner restricts setClaimPrice to the owner.
onlyOwner restricts addAvailableTokens to the owner.
onlyOwner restricts setStartClaimDate to the owner.
onlyOwner restricts reserveDjens to the owner.
claimToken calls getTokenToBeClaimed to select the token id to mint.
claimTokens calls getTokenToBeClaimed once per requested token.
claimToken mints the selected token through _mint.
claimTokens batch mints the selected tokens through _batchMint.
reserveDjens mints the 80 reserved tokens through _batchMint.
reserveDjens calls getTokenToBeClaimed 80 times to fill tokenIds.
withdraw triggers native ether transfers for each collaborator.
withdraw uses mulScale to compute each collaborator share.
getTokenToBeClaimed calls _getRandomNumber to pick a pool index.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external callback into the receiver that can reenter contract logic.
The onERC721Received callback can reenter the payable claimTokens function before state is fully settled.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter is consumed solely as loop bound and pricing factor inside claimTokens.
The _upper parameter only bounds the modulo inside _getRandomNumber.
The _collaborators parameter is only copied into the collaborators array by addCollaborators.
The _claimPrice parameter is written directly to the claimPrice state variable by setClaimPrice.
The _uri parameter is assigned to baseURI by setBaseTokenURI.
The random local exists only as the pool index inside getTokenToBeClaimed.
The tokenId local exists only as the returned selection inside getTokenToBeClaimed.
The totalBalance local exists only to snapshot the balance inside withdraw.
The totalCut local exists only to accumulate collaborator cuts inside addCollaborators.
The from parameter only seeds the range loop inside addAvailableTokens.
The to parameter only terminates the range loop inside addAvailableTokens.
